summary.en-US: The study asks whether R&D spending relative to company size is linked to later stock returns. The current screen finds a positive ranking relationship for some R&D measures, but size and valuation may explain part of it. Historical price checks and financial-report versions remain incomplete, so the result is a research lead rather than a tested trading rule.
summary.zh-CN: 这项研究想知道：相对于公司规模，研发投入是否与之后的股票收益有关。当前筛查发现，部分研发指标与后续收益排序呈正相关，但其中一部分可能来自公司大小和估值。历史价格核查和财报版本仍不完整，因此这只是研究线索，还不是经过验证的交易规则。

label.en-US: Historical execution, input and accounting follow-up
label.zh-CN: 历史执行、输入与会计口径后续核验

label.en-US: Matched historical comparisons and uncertainty method
label.zh-CN: 相同历史样本的对照与不确定性估算方法

question.en-US: Does R&D intensity carry independent information?
question.zh-CN: 研发强度是否包含独立信息？

finding.en-US: The early R&D-to-market-value result and the small-company comparison were both positive, while R&D divided by revenue was close to zero. This raised the question of whether company size, rather than R&D spending, explained the pattern.
finding.zh-CN: 早期“研发 / 市值”结果和小市值对照都为正，而“研发 / 收入”接近零。因此需要继续检查：结果是否与公司规模有关，而不只是研发投入。

decision.en-US: Keep company size and valuation as possible explanations. Do not describe the result as a pure innovation effect.
decision.zh-CN: 公司大小和估值仍可能解释部分结果，因此不能直接把它说成纯粹的创新效应。

question.zh-CN: 不同研发定义是否方向一致？

finding.en-US: There are 77 usable month-end comparisons for the 20-day outcome and 66 for 220 days. After accounting for size, valuation and other listed stock features, the remaining R&D relationship is weaker than the simple R&D-to-market-value measures.
finding.zh-CN: 未来 20 日结果有 77 个可用的月末比较，220 日结果有 66 个。考虑公司大小、估值等列出的股票特征后，剩下的研发关系弱于直接用“研发 / 市值”衡量的结果。

decision.en-US: Keep the 20-day and 220-day sample counts separate. The older yearly reconstruction is a different study record and must not be added to these results.
decision.zh-CN: 20 日和 220 日的样本数分开报告。较早的年度重建是另一份研究记录，不能并入当前结果。

title.en-US: Audit costs and seal prospective evidence
title.zh-CN: 审计成本并封存前瞻证据

question.en-US: Can exploratory labels become executable evidence?
question.zh-CN: 探索性标签能否升级为可执行证据？

finding.en-US: Cost and denominator diagnostics exist; the historical correction chain and long-horizon label maturity remain open.
finding.zh-CN: 已有成本与分母诊断；历史更正链和长期标签成熟仍未完成。

decision.en-US: Keep the October 2026–September 2027 holdout sealed until all labels mature and gates pass; the holdout remains sealed in the meantime.
decision.zh-CN: 2026 年 10 月至 2027 年 9 月留出需等全部标签成熟并通过门禁后解封。

title.en-US: Check accounting definitions across filing samples
title.zh-CN: 跨年报样本核对会计定义

question.en-US: Does a common currency imply the same R&D measure?
question.zh-CN: 币种一致是否代表研发口径一致？

finding.en-US: Ten targeted company-and-year checks cover four companies and five reporting years. Total spending on R&D projects is not the same as the R&D expense recorded in the accounts; one later comparison also disagrees with the saved source value.
finding.zh-CN: 研究挑选了 10 个公司和年度进行核对，覆盖 4 家公司、5 个报告年度。研发项目投入总额与财报里记作费用的研发支出不是同一口径；另有一处后续对照值与存档来源字段不一致。

decision.en-US: Keep each year's total project spending separate from the rolling twelve-month expense measure. These ten checks are too limited to confirm that units and definitions match across the full stock universe.
decision.zh-CN: 每年研发项目投入总额要与滚动 12 个月的研发费用分开记录。这 10 次抽查不足以证明全市场的单位和定义都一致。

title.zh-CN: 拆分失败原因与集中度

question.en-US: Are a few anomalous securities blocking the historical deciles?
question.zh-CN: 历史十分组是否仅被少数异常证券阻断？

finding.en-US: After duplicate records are removed, 10,825 planned position-price checks remain across 3,894 securities. Every R&D-measure-by-stock-group series still has at least one incomplete price check.
finding.zh-CN: 去除重复记录后，3,894 只证券仍有 10,825 个计划持仓价格检查点。每条“研发指标 × 股票分组”序列都至少有一处价格检查不完整。

decision.en-US: Keep the missing-price checks visible while following positions through time; do not fill the gaps with assumed prices. Keep the future test sealed.
decision.zh-CN: 继续跟踪持仓随时间遇到的缺价问题，不用假设价格补齐；未来检验继续封存。

title.en-US: Audit inputs and compare identical samples
title.zh-CN: 审计输入并比较相同样本

question.en-US: Does the numerator explain the same association as valuation?
question.zh-CN: 研发分子能否解释与估值相同的关联？

finding.en-US: A second industry-date mapping matches the saved panel. On the same company rows, smaller size and valuation line up more strongly with the result than logged R&D amount. The source's “inverse size” is negative log market value, so a higher score means a smaller company. These comparisons do not tell us which factor caused the return pattern.
finding.zh-CN: 另一套行业日期匹配与存档面板一致。在完全相同的公司样本上，公司规模较小、估值较高与结果的关系都强于取对数后的研发金额。来源中的“逆规模”是总市值取负对数，因此分数越高，公司越小。这些比较仍不能说明收益模式由哪一项因素造成。

decision.en-US: A field being present in this saved sample does not prove it was public on that historical date. A relationship between rankings is also different from a test of an investable portfolio.
decision.zh-CN: 某个字段出现在这份历史样本中，不代表它在当时已经公开。两种排序有关联，也不等于组合已经通过可交易性验证。

title.en-US: Join historical halt codes and trace retained holdings
title.zh-CN: 对齐停牌代码并追踪实际持仓

question.en-US: Which missing marks have explicit event evidence?
question.zh-CN: 哪些缺价有明确的事件证据？

finding.en-US: Matching explicit BSE suspension codes to company records lets one original monthly series finish its price checks and moves nine others further along. In a separate replay where all variants start in the same month, two of 77-month series finish. All R&D-growth entry months are present, but ten growth series still stop because prices are missing. Eighteen annual-report checks cover four companies and six report years; 16 total-spending values match.
finding.zh-CN: 把北交所明确标记的停牌代码与公司记录对上后，一条原月度序列通过了价格检查，另有 9 条推进了一步。另一项让所有指标从同一个月开始的回放中，有两条 77 个月序列完成。研发增长指标的建仓月份都齐全，但 10 条序列仍因缺少价格而停止。18 项年报核查覆盖 4 家公司、6 个报告年度，其中 16 项投入总额相符。

decision.en-US: Keep the original incomplete-price results and label the same-start replay as a separate diagnostic. A full portfolio validation is still blocked, and the future test remains sealed.
decision.zh-CN: 保留原来未通过的缺价记录，并把共同起点回放明确标成另一项诊断。完整组合验证仍未通过，未来检验继续封存。

title.en-US: Compare R&D with company size and valuation
title.zh-CN: 比较研发投入、公司大小和估值

question.en-US: Does R&D / market cap have a stronger relationship with later returns than size or value alone?
question.zh-CN: 相比只看公司大小或估值，“研发 / 市值”与之后收益的关系更强吗？

finding.en-US: In a separate historical reconstruction, the estimated 95% ranges for the R&D / market-cap result minus the value result, and minus the smaller-company result, both include zero at both time windows. The average year-by-year difference versus smaller-company size was −0.51 percentage points over 20 trading days (3 of 8 years positive) and −2.19 points over 220 days (4 of 7 years positive).
finding.zh-CN: 在另一份历史重建中，无论看 20 日还是 220 日，研发 / 市值结果减去估值对照、或减去小市值对照后得到的 95% 不确定范围都包含零。这表示样本无法判断哪种关系更强。按年度看，研发 / 市值相对小市值对照的平均差：20 日为 −0.51 个百分点（8 年中 3 年为正）；220 日为 −2.19 个百分点（7 年中 4 年为正）。

decision.en-US: When the range includes zero, these data cannot tell which comparison is stronger; that does not prove the effects are equal. The year-by-year figures are descriptive, some years are incomplete, and years are not independent repeats. The 220-day windows overlap. Keep this older reconstruction separate from the corrected 77/66-month screen. There is still no evidence of an independent R&D effect that can be traded.
decision.zh-CN: 区间包含零时，这组数据无法判断哪个对照更强；这不代表已经证明两者效果相同。逐年数字仅用于描述，首尾部分年份不完整，各年也不是互相独立的重复试验；220 日窗口还彼此重叠。请把这份较早的历史重建与修正后的 77／66 个月度筛查分开。目前仍没有证据证明研发存在独立且可交易的影响。

title.en-US: How do the R&D measures compare?
title.zh-CN: 不同研发指标的排序结果怎样？

metric.en-US: Average monthly rank correlation with later stock returns
metric.zh-CN: 与后续股票收益排序的月度平均相关程度

context.en-US: The chart shows the average correlation between the R&D ranking and later stock-return ranking, not a return. There are 77 usable month-end comparisons for 20 trading days and 66 for 220 days. The longer return windows overlap.
context.zh-CN: 图中是研发指标排序与后续股票收益排序的平均相关程度，不是收益率。未来 20 个交易日有 77 个可用月末比较，220 日有 66 个；较长的收益窗口彼此重叠。

interpretation.en-US: Simple R&D-to-market-value measures have a stronger ranking relationship than the fully adjusted remainder. The larger 220-day correlation is still not a return or proof that R&D has an independent, tradable effect.
interpretation.zh-CN: 直接用“研发 / 市值”衡量的指标，与后续收益排序的关系强于充分调整后的剩余部分。220 日相关值更高，但仍不是收益，也不能证明研发有独立、可交易的效果。

categories.en-US: Five-year decayed R&D stock / market cap
categories.zh-CN: 五年衰减研发资本 / 市值

title.en-US: Where did historical price checks find gaps?
title.zh-CN: 历史价格核查发现了哪些缺口？

metric.en-US: Flagged planned holding-price checks / checks performed
metric.zh-CN: 被标记的计划持仓价格检查点 / 已检查点数

context.en-US: A separate reconstructed historical extension for 2019–2026, with incomplete first and last years. The same company may appear in several portfolios. Closing prices and exchange price limits are warning checks, not actual fills; they do not show that an order was placed or actually failed. One position can receive more than one warning.
context.zh-CN: 这是另一份覆盖 2019–2026 年的历史重建，首尾年份不完整。同一家公司可能出现在多个组合里。收盘价和交易所涨跌停规则只用于提示风险，不代表真的下过单或订单确实失败；同一持仓也可能有多个标记原因。

interpretation.en-US: The review found 10,825 distinct company/date/buy-or-sell/reason warnings across 3,894 companies; the ten most frequently flagged companies account for 1.10%. Missing prices on a possible suspension day do not tell us whether a suspension occurred.
interpretation.zh-CN: 核查在 3,894 只证券上发现 10,825 个去重标记，每个标记按证券、日期、买卖方向和原因区分；被标记最多的十只证券占 1.10%。可能停牌的日期缺价格，不能据此断定当天停牌了。

label.zh-CN: 买入端收盘价涨跌停检查
卖出端收盘价涨跌停检查

title.en-US: Are the needed comparison fields present?
title.zh-CN: 用于比较的数据字段是否齐全？

metric.en-US: Rows with a field / rows already retained in the sample
metric.zh-CN: 字段齐全的记录数 / 已保留的样本记录数

context.en-US: This is a separate 2019–2026 historical extension. Coverage is calculated only among rows already retained in this panel (the already filtered panel), not among every stock that may have been eligible. Industry dates were matched again independently, but we have not verified when each historical record became public.
context.zh-CN: 这是另一份 2019–2026 年的历史扩展。覆盖率只在已经保留的面板记录中计算（即已筛选面板），不是对当时所有可能入选股票的覆盖率。行业日期匹配已独立重算，但每条历史记录何时公开仍未核实。

interpretation.en-US: Most retained rows have the named industry or control fields, and the independent industry mapping matches the archived one. That checks alignment; it does not prove the information was available to investors on each historical date. Early years have too few retained rows to represent broad market coverage.
interpretation.zh-CN: 大多数已保留记录都有对应的行业或控制字段，独立行业匹配也与原记录一致。这说明数据对齐结果相符，但不能证明这些资料在历史当时已公开可用。早期保留行太少，不能代表较广的市场覆盖。

label.zh-CN: 四项数值对照字段都齐全

label.en-US: Industry and all four fields recorded
label.zh-CN: 行业和四项数值字段都齐全

title.en-US: Compare R&D amount and company size on the same stocks
title.zh-CN: 在同一批公司中比较研发金额和公司规模

metric.en-US: Average monthly rank correlation using the same stocks within each outcome window
metric.zh-CN: 各收益窗口内使用相同股票计算的月度平均排序相关

context.en-US: This is a separate reconstructed historical extension through 2026-09-30, not the corrected current run. It has 90 usable monthly comparisons for 20 days and 80 for 220 days. All six measures use the same companies on each date, so changing sample membership does not explain their differences. The chart shows ranking correlations, not portfolio returns.
context.zh-CN: 这是截至 2026-09-30 的另一份早期历史重建，不是当前修正后的回放。20 日有 90 个可用月度比较，220 日有 80 个。每个日期的六项指标都使用完全相同的公司，因此差异不会只是股票样本变了造成的。图中是排序相关，不是组合收益。

interpretation.en-US: “Inverse size” means negative log market value: the higher its score, the smaller the company. In this sample, smaller company size and valuation each have a stronger one-at-a-time association than the R&D amount. Earlier checks that considered these factors together gave a different result. Association alone does not show which factor caused the pattern.
interpretation.zh-CN: “逆规模”是总市值取负对数，分数越高代表公司越小。在这组样本中，单独比较时，公司规模较小和估值与结果的关系都强于研发金额；把这些因素一起考虑的早期分析又得到不同结果。仅有相关关系，不能判断究竟是哪项因素造成了结果。

categories.en-US: Book value relative to market value
categories.zh-CN: 账面价值相对股票市值
早期记录中的完整调整后研发指标

title.en-US: How many simulated series passed the price checks?
title.zh-CN: 有多少模拟序列通过了价格核查？

metric.en-US: R&D measure and stock-group result series
metric.zh-CN: 研发指标与股票分组的结果序列

context.en-US: This separate execution check uses 89 month-end portfolio starts (89 formations in the source), seven R&D measures and ten ranked groups, with a modeled one-way cost of 25 basis points (0.25%). The earlier version also counted clearly recorded full-day trading halts. The bars count how many simulated series reached each status; they are not returns and are separate from the 20/220-day signal screen.
context.zh-CN: 这项独立执行核查使用 89 个月末建仓时点、七种研发指标和十个排序组，并假设单边模型成本为 25 个基点（0.25%）。较早版本也计入明确记录的全天停牌。图中统计模拟序列分别走到哪种状态，不是收益表现，也与 20／220 日信号筛查分开。

interpretation.en-US: One series now has complete prices under these checks, but historical financial versions, which companies were eligible on each date, and final prices for delisted companies remain unresolved. Completing this data check does not upgrade the study to validated performance.
interpretation.zh-CN: 目前只有一条序列通过了这些价格检查，但历史财报版本、每个日期哪些公司符合资格，以及退市公司的最终价格仍有缺口。完成这项数据核查，不会让研究自动升级为已验证的收益结果。

label.en-US: Planned holding still has a price gap
label.zh-CN: 计划持仓期间仍缺价格

next_question.en-US: Next, find reliable prices for the remaining held positions, resolve final prices for companies that left the market, and check which companies and financial-report versions were available on each historical date. Keep missing R&D-growth entry months visible. The future test stays sealed.
next_question.zh-CN: 下一步要补查持仓期间缺失的可靠价格、退市公司的最终价格，并核对每个历史日期哪些公司和财报版本当时可用。研发增长缺少建仓月份的问题也要继续保留。未来检验仍封存。

before.en-US: The first R&D-to-market-value result could be mistaken for proof that investors pay a premium for R&D.
before.zh-CN: 最初的“研发 / 市值”结果可能被误读为市场愿意为研发投入支付溢价。

trigger.en-US: The relationship weakens after adjusting for company size, valuation and other stock features, and when R&D is divided by revenue or assets instead.
trigger.zh-CN: 考虑公司大小、估值等股票特征后，或改用收入、资产作分母后，这种关系会减弱。

after.en-US: Keep it as an exploratory pattern linked to valuation. The evidence has not separated an independent R&D effect.
after.zh-CN: 目前只能把它保留为与估值有关的探索性现象；证据还不能分离出独立的研发效果。

before.en-US: A pre-written future test plan could be mistaken for results that are already available.
before.zh-CN: 预先写好的未来检验方案，可能被误认为已经有结果可看。

trigger.en-US: The future observation period is still running, and the longest return windows have not finished.
trigger.zh-CN: 未来观察期还在进行，最长的收益观察窗口也尚未结束。

after.en-US: Keep the future test sealed. This page does not show or authorize access to its performance.
after.zh-CN: 未来检验继续封存。本页面没有展示其表现，也不代表可以读取结果。
